name: EPIC-KITCHENS-100
description: EPIC-KITCHENS-100 is a large-scale egocentric video benchmark capturing daily activities in domestic kitchens. Recorded unscripted using head-mounted cameras across 45 kitchens in 4 cities by 37 participants, it provides 100 hours of continuous high-resolution video (~20 million frames) across 700 recordings. The dataset features 89,977 finely segmented action annotations labeled with 97 verb classes and 300 noun classes, expanding on the original EPIC-KITCHENS-55 release.
